summary: Recon Technology, Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing an at-the-market (ATM) equity issuance sales agreement with Pacific Century Securities, LLC dated July 28, 2026. Under the agreement, the company may sell Class A ordinary shares with aggregate gross proceeds up to $100,000,000 on Nasdaq under an existing F-3 shelf registration statement. The agent receives a commission up to 3.5% of gross proceeds. This is a routine capital-raising facility, not a special situation transaction. The company has no obligation to sell shares and may suspend or terminate sales at any time.
